verdict.line: You lose trades when Rupture (Q) chains into Feral Scream's silence at range; you win when you dodge the knockup and close with Thundering Smash (Q) before Rupture resets.

brief.thesis: This lane is a fight over engage range: Cho'Gath's Rupture (Q) is a 950-range knockup and slow that lets him poke from distance, while Volibear's Sky Splitter (E) answers at 1200 range and his Thundering Smash (Q) closes the gap once Rupture is down. Neither champion has a true gap-closer besides those tools, so whoever controls the 9-second Rupture window controls who gets to fight on their terms. The 45.3% head-to-head over 172 games reflects that Cho'Gath's poke edges out slightly if you let him dictate spacing.

theirWindow.what: He can knock you up and slow you with Rupture, then land Feral Scream's cone silence to shut off your W heal while Vorpal Spikes stack free damage on his autos. Back off to deny the knockup angle rather than trading face-to-face.

yourWindow.when: Rupture (Q) on cooldown, in dash range
yourWindow.what: Close with Thundering Smash's gap-close and stun, then double-tap Frenzied Maul (W) for the bonus damage and heal. Cho'Gath has no sustain until Carnivore triggers off an actual kill, so he loses extended trades here.

runes.keystoneWhy: The ramping attack speed feeds your Relentless Storm passive and lets you stack autos through Feral Scream's silence window, which is the higher-performing page at 53.6% WR versus the Resolve secondary page's 41.8%.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate and win rate combo (73.3% pick, 48.8% WR); Ignite punishes his Carnivore healing on kills and secures early solo kills before he stacks Feast.

playing.title: Track Rupture's 9-second cooldown
playing.detail: It's short enough that you can bait it out with a safe poke, then step in during the window before it resets.

playing.title: Poke with Sky Splitter at range
playing.detail: When he's standing inside your 1200-range Sky Splitter (E), use it to contest instead of walking up into Rupture range.

playing.title: All-in only when Q is down
playing.detail: Thundering Smash (Q) closes the gap and stuns on first hit, which is your best engage since he has no gap-closer besides walking.

playing.title: Respect the silence chain
playing.detail: Rupture into Feral Scream can lock out your W heal cast entirely, so don't commit to a double-tap Frenzied Maul into an unused Feral Scream.

playing.title: Double-tap Frenzied Maul in trades
playing.detail: The second cast on a marked target deals bonus damage and heals you; he has zero sustain until Carnivore actually triggers off a kill.

playing.title: Save Stormbringer for forced fights
playing.detail: From level 7-11 onward, leap in with R to slow and lean on the bonus health, since that's where your sustain starts outscaling his poke.

playing.title: Punish him right after a Feast kill
playing.detail: Feast stacks grow his max HP up to 6 times but he loses half on death, so look to all-in immediately after he dies rather than let him reset.

brief.patchCaveat: The 45.3% head-to-head win rate over 172 games, build paths, runes, and summoner spells are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the cooldown timings, trade windows, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Cho’Gath’s (Q). Use [E] to contest lane while fighting it when it stands in your range to gain the upper hand.
